sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older stern man in three-quarter screen-left pose; receding silver-gray and dark slicked-back hair, short dark-gray side hair and visible gray brows. Clean bare cheeks, upper lip and chin with no moustache or beard; preserve the small dark brown spot above the outer screen-right eyebrow and lined serious expression. Charcoal-blue suit with broad notched lapels, pale gray-white shirt closed at the throat, muted olive-gold necktie; no hat or spectacles. Keep upper-left light, dark gray painted rectangular backing and original crop. Alpha252..255 is recorded without interpreting it as a cutout; the visible background is a complete painted rectangle. Compact mascot head and a short broad neck seated close in the shirt collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up dark-haired bearded naval officer looking upward and toward screen-left, head and shoulders turned slightly left, serious mouth. Visible black eyebrows, dark sideburns and a full dark beard framing cheeks/jaw/chin with a connected moustache. Large white peaked naval cap tilted with the pose, black band, central black/gold badge with a tiny red top detail and gold leafy embroidery across the black visor; preserve source shapes without inventing readable insignia. Dark navy jacket with broad folded lapels, pale gray-blue shirt and black necktie. Retain light gray-green complete painted background, source crop and light direction; fit the same collar to a short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing chest-up naval officer with nearly centered shoulders, firm closed mouth, dark brows and short dark side hair; closely trimmed dark beard across cheeks/jaw/chin, connected moustache and a darker small central chin tuft. White peaked naval cap, black band, central black and gold wreath-like badge with tiny red/cream top detail, gold cord and gold leaves on the black visor. Navy broad-lapelled uniform over a pale gray-blue shirt and dark tie. Preserve actual insignia arrangement and colors without claiming the tiny emblem's identity; keep the complete light gray-green painted background and frontal lighting. Adapt the original shirt opening to a compact broad yellow mascot head with a short neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven young army officer looking slightly toward screen-left, neatly cropped straight brown hair visible at temples and sideburns beneath a broad olive peaked cap, dark visible brows, calm closed mouth. Keep smooth bare cheeks, upper lip and chin, with no moustache or beard. Cap has a vivid red band, gold oval center badge with an indistinct light figure, brown leather strap and short olive visor; retain the actual shape/color without inventing fine emblem details. Olive service jacket with shoulder tabs and small gold collar badges, khaki shirt and olive tie. Preserve cream-gray complete painted backing, crop and original left-side lighting; short broad mascot neck fitted directly into the buttoned collar.
